source_boundary.selection: rank zero of the directly connected accepted ace3_streaming_tied_lm_head_topk output
source_boundary.tie_break: descending rounded finite FP16 logit, then ascending token ID

bindings.state_tip: nonzero trusted and presented 256-bit values must match
bindings.position: next_position must equal prior_position plus one without overflow

feedback_protocol.top_k: ranks 0 through 9 exactly once; rank zero is held as selected-token output
feedback_protocol.embedding_request: issued only for the captured RTL rank-zero token
feedback_protocol.embedding: exactly 896 ordered finite FP16 words for that same token
feedback_protocol.next_input: ready/valid stream preserves token, feature, FP16 bits, last, and next position
feedback_protocol.commit: emitted only after all 896 next-input words are accepted and carries prior state tip, selected token, and next position
feedback_protocol.error_recovery: binding, order, framing, nonfinite, substitution, and duplicate faults are sticky until clear or reset

tokenizer_decode_metadata.producer: post-terminal comparator driven by the raw RTL-selected token
tokenizer_decode_metadata.oracle_role: comparison only; never drives RTL selection or embedding address

causal_state_commitment: SHA256(domain || prior_state_tip || selected_token_le32 || next_position_le32 || 896 little-endian FP16 words)

claim_boundary.demonstrated: standalone accepted final-RMSNorm hidden through RTL lm_head selection and exact tied-embedding feedback
